learning_objective: 🎯 We will read a fun story about a clever monkey swinging from the trees!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Monkeys love to live in tall trees and swing from branch to branch.
Monkeys are very active, playful, and they love eating tasty bananas.
The monkey is very smart and uses its quick thinking to solve problems.

fun_activity.title: 🐵 Monkey Mask
fun_activity.instructions: Ask an adult to help you cut a monkey face out of a paper plate. Color it brown, tie a string, and wear your monkey mask!

quick_recap: ⭐ Monkeys live in trees and have long tails.
⭐ They love jumping and eating bananas.
⭐ They are very smart and playful animals.
